The model

serialization v1
concept noteworthy artifact goal · investigation · task waypoint
one
Single typed edge table
Every relationship is a row in one table. Inventories are queries over edges, never stored lists that can drift.
every
Content-addressed provenance
Each entity traces to a verbatim source excerpt, both sides of the exchange, addressed by a hash that changes if a byte does.

self
Dogfooded
konspekt records its own design decisions in konspekt, so the standard is tested by the work that builds it.
Principlesthe invariants everything rests on
  • The store stays dumb. The backing store reads and writes; it never adjudicates a proposal. Review lives in the conversation.
  • The read path is neutral. Any instance is plain files anyone can re-read without an API, so nothing becomes lock-in.
  • Distribution is a projection. Anything published is regenerated from the graph, never a second copy that can drift from it.
  • Convergent merge, asymmetric accept. Anyone may propose and it all merges; a named authority decides what is accepted.
